objective: Review the importable non-executing direct command-path fixture helper and accept only the reference-only parser-to-sidecar-boundary metadata, without claiming native Verilator option support, direct command execution, RTL simulation, coverage-output equivalence evidence, timing, arbitrary filelist support, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, or raw full-state equality.

review_decision.reason: The helper matches the accepted fixture contract: it reuses the parser-stub fixture for expanded native-minimum argv, distinguishes mixed compact/expanded spelling before parser fallback, requires explicit sidecar context, rejects parser payloads that already contain sidecar-owned fields, and returns only reference-style sidecar_plan_boundary metadata with all execution, measurement, timing, source-closure, filelist-expansion, and automatic-allocation flags false.
review_decision.weakest_point: The helper is still exactly a non-executing fixture, and its parser_payload entrypoint does not yet strictly require every reviewed parser-owned input field before returning boundary metadata. The next gate must define payload-validation hardening before sidecar-plan materialization or any direct command-path execution boundary.
accepted_because: the output field set is explicit and includes false execution_performed, measurement_performed, timing_measured, runtime_or_abi_changed, source_closure_inferred, filelists_expanded, and automatic_gpu_allocation_used flags
ordinary Verilator args, mdir, top module, source files, filelists, defines, include dirs, and warning flags are preserved as parser build inputs without source-closure inference
sidecar_plan_boundary is structured reference metadata only and does not invoke sidecar_stage_plan, handoff contracts, command synthesis, operator plans, or efficiency estimates
compact-only and mixed compact/expanded shape spelling are rejected at the direct fixture layer with distinct error codes
missing explicit sidecar context and parser-prepopulated sidecar-owned fields fail closed before boundary metadata is returned
the helper adds no public CLI, Verilator source-tree dependency, runtime or ABI change, execution path, measurement path, or new workload

accepted_followup_gap.name: parser_payload_required_field_validation_gap
accepted_followup_gap.description: The argv path uses the parser-stub fixture, but the parser-payload entrypoint can accept a hand-built payload that omits reviewed identity/build-input fields such as schema_version, surface, mdir, or top_module. That is narrow enough for a review-only acceptance because no execution authority is returned, but it must be hardened before sidecar-plan materialization.

accepted_scope.line_guard_margin: at the 250 added-line guard; future growth should split reusable behavior or shrink the helper before adding logic

required_next_gate.name: define_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_fixture_payload_validation_hardening_gate
must_define: the complete required parser-payload field set for direct_command_parser_payload_to_sidecar_plan_fixture

strict rejection for missing schema_version, surface, accelerator_mode, correctness_policy, state_count, step_count, shape, mdir, top_module, ordinary_verilator_args, source_files, filelists, defines, include_dirs, and warning_flags fields
strict rejection for parser payloads whose identity fields do not match the direct command-path fixture contract
tests proving hardening occurs before sidecar_plan_boundary metadata is returned

how this hardening remains non-executing and does not materialize sidecar stages, infer source closure, expand filelists, execute commands, compare outputs, measure timing, change runtime/ABI, or allocate GPU work

not coverage-output equivalence for a direct native-parser flow
not source-closure or filelist dependency inference
